caption:
A question from Allah about gratitude

Allah asks this question Himself, and then tells us He is ever Appreciative. Before Friday begins, count three things you have been given and thank Him for each.

Surah An-Nisaa 4:147

Name three blessings you can thank Allah for right now.

#gratitude #shukr #surahnisa #quranreels

Recitation: Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais
